used_propositions: Company registry number 09338441 is recorded under the registered name VELLUM PRINT CO LTD in England and Wales with status dissolved.
Billing records identify the billed party as Vellum Print Co Ltd.
The registry registered name VELLUM PRINT CO LTD and the billing billed name Vellum Print Co Ltd are orthographically the same aside from letter casing.
support_claim: No proposition establishes identity or distinctness; although the names match aside from casing, the evidence only characterizes each referent and does not establish that billing:Vellum Print Co Ltd and registry:09338441 denote the same legal counterparty.
